mapper.select: SELECT id, config_key, CAST(config_value AS CHAR) as config_value, config_name, description, config_group, enabled, sort_order, create_time, update_time FROM ai_config WHERE config_key = #{configKey}

SELECT id, config_key, CAST(config_value AS CHAR) as config_value, config_name, description, config_group, enabled, sort_order, create_time, update_time FROM ai_config WHERE config_group = #{configGroup} ORDER BY sort_order ASC

SELECT id, config_key, CAST(config_value AS CHAR) as config_value, config_name, description, config_group, enabled, sort_order, create_time, update_time FROM ai_config WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY config_group ASC, sort_order ASC

update.foreach: UPDATE ai_config SET config_value = #{config.configValue}, config_name = #{config.configName}, description = #{config.description}, enabled = #{config.enabled}, update_time = NOW() WHERE config_key = #{config.configKey}
